checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Metal rim with rubber tire combination.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The inner edges of the front wheel spokes show slight softness and lack of crisp definition compared to the outer rim, suggesting minor generative smoothing or resolution loss, though not structurally broken.

The rear wheel appears slightly more elliptical than the front wheel despite being on the same plane, indicating a very subtle perspective inconsistency, but it remains within plausible photographic variance.

Tire-to-rim interface for gaps or fusion
